capabilities.title: Repository Review
capabilities.summary: Review a repository revision against the rules carried by the Skill source.
intents: The user wants an evidence-backed review of a code change.

tasks.objective: Review the selected repository revision and report evidence-backed findings.

success_criteria.text: Every finding cites a repository path and revision.

deliverables.description: A Markdown report listing findings, risk and suggested follow-up.
A proposed tracker update summarising the review outcome.

resource_requirements.selection_guidance: Prefer the revision named by the user; ask when it is not stated.
Use the project review checklist when one is bound.
Only needed when the user asks for the outcome to be recorded.

required_rules.text: Every finding must cite the repository path and revision it was observed in.

recommended_steps.text: Read the changed files before judging the change as a whole.
Group findings by severity and explain the reasoning behind each one.

quality_criteria.text: Each finding states what to change and why it matters.

prohibited_actions.text: Do not present a rewritten file as if it were the reviewed revision.

interaction_points.condition: The user did not name the revision to review.
A tracker update was proposed and needs approval before it is applied.

effect_intents.operation: Read the reviewed revision and its changed files.
Record the review outcome on the tracked issue.

session_split_hints.text: Continue in a new Session once the user has responded to the review.

stop_conditions.text: Stop and ask when the requested revision cannot be read.

source_traces.reason: The Overview section describes reviewing a repository revision.
The Goal section defines the review objective and its report.
The Inputs section requires a repository revision.
The Rules section states that findings must cite evidence.
The Follow-up section asks for the outcome to be recorded on the tracker.

assumptions.text: The first version reviews one repository revision per Run.

questions.text: Which severity scale should findings use?
